SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-01: FHIRPath — §4.1 Literals. Test these items: Boolean literals, String literals, Integer literals, Decimal literals, Date literals, Time literals, DateTime literals, Quantity literals (incl. time-valued quantities). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.summary: DateTime literals now reject timezone offsets beyond +/-14:00 in Python fallback and native DuckDB; detailed evidence archived in ARCHIVE_LOG.md.
